note: Screen S6 (output/research/screen7/s6_preseason.json; Fodor, Patterson & Shank 2025). Weeks 2-8: bet the side preseason win totals favor when the market's home margin is 4+ points away from the preseason-implied margin. 2013-2025 at the closing number/price: 332 bets, 60.5% cover, ROI +16.5% +- 5.1% (p 0.0007), 11/13 seasons positive, 2024-25 (after the paper) +7%; same rule in weeks 9-18 covers 49% (placebo). 3 thresholds were examined (2/3/4); 4 was the strongest, 3 was pre-declared primary (p 0.034) - treat as a candidate, judged on 2026+ results. The edge claims the closing line itself is wrong, so it is graded on results (ATS at our price), CLV informational. Post-hoc diagnostic (not part of the rule): bets on teams whose starting QB changed since week 1 covered 56.5% vs 62.7% unchanged; shown as a label. Do not edit to fit results; bump the version.
